Package com.ucm.client.views.original.controllers

Class GenericController

java.lang.Object
com.ucm.client.views.original.controllers.GenericController
Direct Known Subclasses:
AddBotsCreateGameWindowController, AddCardsCreateGameWindowController, AddPlayersCreateGameWindowController, AddTableCreateGameWindowController, ChooseGameWindowController, HomeCreateGameWindowController, InGameWindowController, MainWindowController, ProfileSecondWindowController, StartWindowController, WaitingGameWindowController
public abstract class GenericController extends Object
GenericController is an abstract class that serves as a base for all controllers in the application. It provides common functionality for managing the main controller, stage, and client information.
